sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A rogue who serves as the right-hand man to the female leader of a bandit group. Originally affiliated with a criminal organization in the eastern part of Artoria, he lost his place in the city due to allegations of betrayal and drifted to the west. The previous leader recognized his skills and intellect, and he rapidly rose to an executive position within the gang. His exceptional contributions and meteoric rise became the stuff of legends, earning him respect from the outlaws of the west. He later set his sights on ancient relics excavated from a particular mine and hatched a plan to seize the land for the woman he loved.
